# NavAura Care

> NavAura Care Pty Ltd is a registered NDIS provider (registration 4-MBZ2CY4, ABN 95 693 402 318) based in Liverpool NSW 2170, Australia. It provides disability support to NDIS participants and families across Western and South West Sydney, including Liverpool, Blacktown, Merrylands, Bankstown, Fairfield and Parramatta. Support is available 24/7. Phone 0431 404 000, email services@navauracare.com.au, website https://www.navauracare.com.au/.

## Key facts
- Registered NDIS provider, supports NDIA-managed, plan-managed and self-managed participants
- Replies to every referral within 24 hours; meet-and-greet before services begin
- Workers speak English, Hindi, Punjabi, Telugu, Arabic, Greek, Vietnamese and African languages
- Does not provide allied health, therapy, clinical mental health treatment or plan management; can refer to allied health providers
- Accommodation/tenancy support: no SDA properties available at the moment

## Services
- [Personal care and daily living](https://www.navauracare.com.au/personal-care.html): showering, dressing, meals, medication prompts, household tasks, overnight support, 1:1 and 2:1 support where funded
- [High intensity support](https://www.navauracare.com.au/high-intensity-support.html): complex bowel care, PEG feeding, catheter care, epilepsy management
- [Supported Independent Living (SIL)](https://www.navauracare.com.au/supported-living.html): drop-in to 24/7 support in shared or individual homes
- [Psychosocial support](https://www.navauracare.com.au/psychosocial-support.html): non-clinical, recovery-focused support
- [Community participation](https://www.navauracare.com.au/community.html): outings, activities, sport, hobbies and groups
- [Early childhood supports](https://www.navauracare.com.au/children.html): everyday support for children and families, mentoring, help around school
- [Accessible transport](https://www.navauracare.com.au/transport.html): wheelchair-accessible van with a support worker
- [Accommodation/tenancy support and SDA](https://www.navauracare.com.au/sda.html)
- [Support coordination Level 1 and Level 2](https://www.navauracare.com.au/support-coordination.html)
